reasoning_content:
API basic auth may be disabled by default (REST API requires authentication setting). But the key verification is HTTP page loads and DB state. Let me not over-focus on API. The core install is verified: container running, postgres cluster created, seeding completed, web server answering HTTP 200/302.

Let me verify login works properly now through the web form.

action.command:
COOKIE=/tmp/op5.txt; rm -f $COOKIE
curl -s -c $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/login -o /tmp/lp3.html
TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/lp3.html | tail -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
curl -s -b $COOKIE -c $COOKIE -o /tmp/lr3.html -w "login HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "username=admin" --data-urlencode "password=AdminPass12345!" \
  http://localhost:8080/login
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/lr3.html | head -1
echo "=== authenticated home ==="
curl -s -b $COOKIE -o /tmp/home.html -w "home HTTP %{http_code}\n" -L http://localhost:8080/
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/home.html | head -1
echo "=== top nav user ==="; grep -o -i "admin" /tmp/home.html | head -2
